title: Responsive sectional guide and expanded EPG
notes: Stops loading the complete global programme index for every folder. OpenTV now queries only the selected section in safe database batches, preventing the large guide allocation that caused remote lag, ANRs and memory-pressure exits. The full 25,395-stream catalogue remains available. Roku, Tubi and global Plex schedules raise the combined guide to 8,523 guide channels and 342,325 real programme entries. Existing favourites, folders, hidden channels, settings, add-ons and logins are preserved.
